bullets: Added a one-time $500 advertiser signup credit for spending $500 on placements within 30 days of creating an ads account.
Changed paid-social click attribution to per-platform windows, giving X a 90-day window while TikTok keeps the 7-day window.
Restored Gemini 3.8 Flash to the CLI and Desktop model pickers, locked behind a paid plan for accounts without a live plan.
Added thumbs up or down rating to feedback submissions, allowing no-text one-click feedback.
Capped follow-up suggestion tool calls at 8 per response and cancelled the step request when the cap is exceeded.
Made repeated unchanged to-do lists a no-op instead of treating them as fresh successes.
Added per-platform Meta Ads acquisition pixel ID and event support for Ads acquisition.
Removed the advertiser reason redaction module that generalized internal operator reasons into advertiser-visible buckets.
